action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Add data-testid='kpi-simplicidad', 'kpi-logica', 'kpi-fluidez' to the three inline KPI spans in GuardianLogicoModule.js (currently the values are rendered as inline text in the header).
critical_code_review_comments: GuardianLogicoModule load() uses Promise.all([guardian/estado, tema-vivo/estado]) — if EITHER fails the whole state stays null causing potential 0% permanent state. Consider Promise.allSettled + graceful fallback per API so partial data still renders (would prevent the suspected 0% edge case if one endpoint 401/500s).
MartinTallerModule wrapper uses testid 'martin-taller' while others use '{module}-module' suffix — consider aligning naming convention across modules for testability.

rca of the issue: Suspected 0% score in prior screenshot: NOT reproduced in this run. Root cause of the earlier screenshot most likely mid-render capture (before Promise.all resolved).
